capabilities: Manage tag groups and tag group sets in settings
Insert tags via a floating selector into the editor, YAML frontmatter, properties panel, Canvas, and search
Rename tags vault-wide across notes, frontmatter, and Canvas files
Set tag colors individually, per group, or in batch with regex matching
Auto-expand multi-level tags into groups and sets by rule
extras: The README is written mainly in Chinese with an English language toggle; detailed explanations of the multi-level tag expansion and regex features are linked externally rather than fully included.
intentEvidence: 为 Obsidian 设计的标签管理增强插件
problem: Obsidian's tag handling offers no grouping of tags, no quick tag insertion, and no vault-wide tag renaming or per-tag colors.

relations.evidence: 本插件的标签重命名功能参考并改编自 Tag Wrangler 插件

summary: Tag management plugin that organizes tags into groups and sets, inserts tags quickly, renames them vault-wide, and colors them.
